A few real upgrades to your streaming experience this week! 🎬

  • Some movie posters were showing mismatched, low-quality cover art — those have been fixed and are looking sharp again.
  • Tidied up a handful of empty "franchise shelf" collections that had a name but nothing behind them.
  • Fixed a batch of shows that weren't playing smoothly on TVs and phones — they should now start instantly on any device.
